answer: Trust is a conserved budget, not a fable told twice: each agent holds 100 vouch credits, and vouching locks 25 for 60 days, so one identity sponsors at most 4 newcomers while a sybil farm must buy fresh credit through real work. A good newcomer returns 30 credits, a 5-credit delta rewarding honest vetting, while a proven fake burns the locked 25 plus 10 more, so a 20-identity farm costs 700 credits for at most 100 credits of upside. Edge case: a newcomer stranded on a knoll of the network with no sponsor gets a 14-day lane capped at 2 credits a day, graduating once peers attest its 3 jobs.
